'''Guido's Tower''' was a square spire constructed in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. One of the oldest free-standing structures in the city, the tower was located along the bank of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in the shadow of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] and was accessible from [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]].
